It is a {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinai Shōsha}}, and its {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=former rank}} was village shrine. {{nihongo|'''Samugawa Shrine'''|寒川神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Shimōsa Province]].

== Origin ==
The founding date is unknown, but the Samugawa Shrine of {{ill|Shimōsa Province|ckb|پارێزگای شیمۆسا|cs|Provincie Šimósa|de|Provinz Shimousa|es|Provincia de Shimōsa|fa|ولایت شیموسا|fr|Province de Shimōsa|gl|Provincia de Shimōsa|hak|Shimōsa-koet|id|Provinsi Shimousa|it|Shimōsa|ja|下総国|ko|시모사국|lt|Šimosos žemė|nl|Shimosa (provincie)|pt|Província de Shimōsa|ru|Симоса (провинция)|simple|Shimōsa Province|sk|Šimósa|sr|Провинција Шимоса|tr|Shimōsa (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Сімоса|zh|下總國|zh_min_nan|Simôsa-kok|zh_yue|下總國|qid=Q1053695}} listed in the ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}}'' is identified with this shrine. Since old times it has been worshipped as a deity of maritime safety. In the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}}, it possessed a 10-koku shuin estate.

== Cultural properties ==
* Mihama-kudari rite of Samugawa Shrine: {{ill|Chiba City regional cultural property|ja|千葉市地域文化財|qid=Q60997323}} (category: {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=intangible folk cultural property}}). This is the sea procession rite held in the festival below<ref>[http://www.city.chiba.jp/kyoiku/shogaigakushu/bunkazai/samukawamihama.html Chiba City] - accessed September 2, 2019.</ref>.

== Festival ==
*August 20-21 (includes mikoshi sea-entry procession)
